title: fix(plugin-security): a delegated administrator's refused assignment write answers the same for a row it cannot read as for a missing one
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：委派管理员（持有 `adminScope` 的调用者，包括同时持有 `adminScope` 的组织管理员）按 id 修改或删除授权行（`sys_user_position`、`sys_user_permission_set`）被拒时，对它读不到的行和根本不存在的 id 给出完全相同的回答（状态码、错误码、文案、details 全同）；委派管理闸门先以调用者自己的读取取得这一行，读得到的行仍按存储行判定。
- 为什么改：落实 ruling 5985885287（调用者读不到的行与不存在的 id 回答一致，对所有主体类别都适用）；组织管理员分支已由 #29932 落地，本 PR 把这条规则落到委派分支，以及“组织管理员兼持 adminScope”这一类调用者。
- 风险与回滚：只改委派分支判断“有没有这一行”的读取来源；读得到的行判定与提示不变，原本放行的写入仍放行（含对该表无读权限的委派者），插入、租户级管理员、不持 adminScope 的组织管理员都不经此改动；唯一可见变化是不存在的 id 的删除由引擎的 404 改为闸门的 403（一种拒绝换成另一种）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 `delegatedTargets` 与 `hiddenFromCaller`（风险 hunk：读取被拒绝不算“读不到”，仍按存储行判）；`security-plugin.ts` 中 `readAsCaller` 的接线；`org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`，预期 70/70 通过（含 `group` / `isolated` 下三类委派调用者的新用例与 `single` 对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The delegated walk asks the caller first.** `DelegatedAdminGate` (ADR-0090 D12) judges a delegate's by-id update or delete of an assignment row (`sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`) only once the caller's own by-id read of that row — the read door's answer to this caller, every read visibility and wall included — has returned it. The read is #29932's organization-branch read, now one method (`callerRead`) both branches use.
- **No row is one answer, given at the gate.** When the caller's read returns no row — the id names no row, or the caller cannot read it — the write is refused there: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, "the assignment row it addresses could not be read", details `{ operation, object }`. Neither case reaches the engine, so a removal of an id that names no row now answers that refusal instead of `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`.
- **A row the caller reads is judged on the stored row, as before**, so its verdict and its guidance are unchanged. The caller's own read is served through its field-level security, and a judgement made on what a field rule hid would be made on less than the row; the posture rig pins this.
- **A read the read door refuses outright (a declared 4xx) hides no row.** The stored row is judged as before, and a refusal the gate then answers for the by-id write the caller addressed is answered with that read refusal by the security middleware (`readDoorAnswerForGateRefusal`), for every id alike — the same reading the by-id write door gives such a caller. A store fault in either read propagates as raised.
- **One caller read per operation.** The security plugin passes the gate its per-operation pre-image read (`readAsCaller` → `getCallerPreImage`), so the organization branch, the delegated walk and the read-door questions after them share one read of the row.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch.

## Tests

- **Engine level, real `ObjectQL` + SQL driver + `SecurityPlugin`** (`org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`, new top-level describe; the harness now also registers the two business-unit objects):
  - under `group` and `isolated`, for three callers — a delegate, an organization administrator who also holds the scope, and a delegate refused the read of both tables — and both tables, the update and the delete of a row the caller cannot read answer exactly what the same write answers for an id that names no row, compared whole (status, code, sentence, details); the no-row answer is the gate's 403, never the engine's; the row stays;
  - control: a row inside the scope that the caller reads is admitted; a row of its own organization outside the scope keeps the guidance naming its unit or its holder and is not answered as no row, after one read of the row as the caller; an assignment whose position a field rule hides from the caller is still held to the allowlist;
  - control, `single`: a row the delegate reads keeps its guidance, and every in-scope update and delete lands — the delegate refused the read included — reading the row as the caller once.
- **HTTP door** (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/delegated-admin-assignment-write-unreadable-row.dogfood.test.ts`, showcase behind a real `isolated` wall, the showcase's own `showcase_field_ops_delegate` set): for a delegate and for an organization owner who also holds the set, `PATCH` and `DELETE` of an assignment row the caller cannot read answer exactly what an id naming no row answers; the row stays. Controls: the wall is real, each caller reads no such row; a row inside the scope that the delegate wrote is admitted; a row outside it keeps the guidance naming its unit.
- **One-shot ablations**, not kept (each restored blob == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - engine, the caller-visibility question removed (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 time, blob `78e3ddaf` → `47eb74de`): posture rig 2 failed | 68 passed — the two walled "answers exactly what an id naming no row answers" cases; every control green;
  - engine, the shared-read wiring removed (blob `4e1045f1` → `e13d4015`): 3 failed | 67 passed — the three cases that count the caller's reads of the row (2, not 1);
  - HTTP, the visibility question made to answer "readable" always (blob `78e3ddaf` → `35c1210c`), plugin-security rebuilt, `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/plugin-security PLANTED_TEXT` exit 0 (hit `dist/index.js`, `dist/index.mjs`): dogfood pin 1 failed | 2 passed — the unreadable-row case; restored, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0, 3/3.

## Acceptance notes

- **Why `Clause-②: no`.** The writes this newly refuses are by-id updates and deletes whose row the caller's read does not return; each was refused before too. An id naming no row was refused by the gate or answered `404` by the engine. A row the caller cannot read was refused by the gate or answered `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` by the by-id write door's own read question — measured on the real engine under `group` and `isolated` for rows whose stored image is inside the scope (before: 404, row untouched; after: the gate's 403, row untouched). Every admission stays: in-scope rows the caller reads are admitted under all three postures, and a delegate refused the read keeps its in-scope writes under `single` (pinned).
- The posture rig's `test-budget: 20` header was written at 60 cases; the file now holds 70, and its tests took 8.9 s here on a shared box, inside the budget.
- `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`'s harness reads through a fake `ql` that ignores context, so its by-id cases stand for a caller who reads the row; their expectations are unchanged.
